fullPassage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and environmental performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help enhance the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."

questions.passage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and environmental performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help enhance the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 11번과 다른 표현으로 같은 주제를 파악한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 트리플 보텀 라인(기업 사회적 책임) + 학생 설문(미래 세대 가치관)을 모두 포괄 ←정답
❌ ② 연봉 협상은 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ③ 환경 규제의 부정적 영향은 본문 논점이 아님
❌ ④ 법적 근거는 본문에 제시되지 않음
det.tip: 두 축 — 기업 가치관 + 청년층 선호 — 을 모두 담은 선지를 찾으세요.
